items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Fletcher asked me to go with him... So that's when I joined Fletcher

ctx.x: And then, is that when Fletcher...?

Yeah, Fletcher asked me to go with him, and I had saved up about five hundred dollars, and I just figured... I told Fletcher I had to go home, but I didn't get no farther than Philadelphia. I went over there with the five hundred dollars and got stranded, you know, with gambling, and I'd take all my buddies out when I'd go to jam, you know, and buying drinks. I had a silver dollar left, and I pawned that to corral my aunt here in New York to get five dollars to get home. It only cost two dollars and something at…
Was Chu already with him then?
